model: At the original modeled exit, sell up to the saved 60-second pre-exit participation capacity. For residual inventory, submit at exit+10, +15, ... through the named horizon. At each submission, capacity is participation times netted economic flow in the immediately preceding completed five-second interval, ending five seconds before submission; intervals never overlap the initial window or each other. Sell up to that capacity at the first observed swap price within ten seconds. Missing fills recover zero by the horizon. Charge half the saved round-trip fee for every later attempt with positive observed capacity; the alternate fee mode uses the larger of that amount and the pre-exit median transaction gas plus MEV, and tops up the first exit fee to that median. Retain original entries, sizes and trigger times. This is a fixed-roster sensitivity, not a deployable order strategy or executable AMM quote.
scope: New trade rows were acquired after the historical event. Original rows are preserved through each original request end; later rows extend the window. Recorded prices and volume are proxies. Closed-equity drawdown excludes intratrade lows. Result cannot establish a positive live edge.
